blocks.text:
29 October.

One final, unhurried day in paradise, to be enjoyed exactly as you please. We suggest exploring the hidden colonial alleys of Santa Teresa, a hilltop neighborhood of cobbled streets, century-old mansions and the charming yellow tram rattling past, or soaking up the bohemian charm of Lapa, where the illuminated arches pulse with live samba after dark. If the ocean calls one last time, return to its turquoise embrace for a final swim. However you choose to spend it, Rio will make it unforgettable.

30 October.

A private transfer ensures a graceful departure, but not all of you will leave. You carry home the warmth of the people, a rhythm that now lives in your step, and the indelible spirit of a country that welcomes rather than merely hosts.

Transfer to GRU Airport with an English-speaking guide. Your departure airport and return transfer arrangements will be confirmed when you book.
